verdict.rationale: Gide Loyrette Nouel is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software product, so reading product source under an open license is a category error for this kind of offering. Its IT practice advises clients on open-source protection, but that is legal advice about other parties' software, not the firm shipping its own source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
